propositions: Fresh full clone of tickets costs 1.04 GiB / 59s wall time on CI; partial clone with blob:none filter reduces to 68.7 MiB / 14.3s (15x reduction).
Fetch timeout in Claude Code web environment silently bootstraps orphan branch instead of failing, producing empty divergent store where reads return [] and writes cannot fast-forward to origin.
Partial clone with blob:none is safe for rebar access patterns because tree-level verification scans work entirely on working-tree blobs and merge-base logic is preserved (full commit graph remains).
On fetch failure, rebar must exit non-zero without creating an orphan worktree instead of falling through to worktree add --orphan bootstrap.
derive_caused_by must abort and return None on any per-path git blame failure rather than tallying partial results, preventing incorrect caused_by links.
Runner must support blob:none partial clone inherit on subsequent manual tickets fetches and succeed on reconverge against diverged remote with merge.ours.driver defined.
